reading: US President Donald Trump and China's President Xi Jinping met for a big dinner.
They exchanged warm words at the dinner, but they did not show much progress on big issues.
Many business leaders and tech company heads also went to the dinner.
President Trump gave President Xi a sculpture of a bald eagle as a gift.
The dinner food had American and Chinese styles.
They will meet again for tea the next day.

vocabulary.definition: The highest leader of a country.
The main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening.
To give something to someone and receive something in return.
People who guide or direct others.
Something given to someone, often to show friendship or thanks.

entries.zh-Hans: 一个国家的最高领导人。
entries.es: El líder de más alto rango de un país.
entries.pt-BR: O líder de mais alta autoridade de um país.

entries.ja: 一日の主な食事で、たいてい夕方に食べるもの。
entries.ko: 하루 중 주된 식사로, 보통 저녁에 먹는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 一天中的主餐，通常在晚上吃。
entries.es: La comida principal del día, generalmente consumida por la noche.
entries.pt-BR: A principal refeição do dia, geralmente consumida à noite.

entries.ja: 誰かに何かを与え、そのお返しに何かを受け取ること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 다른 사람에게 주고 그 대가로 어떤 것을 받는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 将某物给予某人，并作为交换得到某物。
entries.es: Darle algo a alguien y recibir algo a cambio.
entries.pt-BR: Dar algo a alguém e receber algo em troca.

entries.ja: 前に進むこと、または改善。
entries.es: El movimiento hacia adelante o una mejora.

entries.ja: 他の人々を導いたり指示したりする人々。
entries.es: Personas que guían o dirigen a otros.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas que guiam ou direcionam outras.

entries.ja: 誰かに与えられるもので、しばしば友情や感謝を示すために贈られる。
entries.ko: 다른 사람에게 주어지는 것으로, 주로 우정이나 감사를 표현하기 위해 주는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 送给别人的东西，通常是为了表达友谊或感谢。
entries.es: Algo que se le da a alguien, a menudo para mostrar amistad o agradecimiento.
entries.pt-BR: Algo dado a alguém, muitas vezes para demonstrar amizade ou agradecimento.
